entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't work. They're giving me terrible blisters.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I know how uncomfortable that can be. Have you had a chance to adjust the cleats or the insole? Sometimes a small adjustment can make a world of difference in fit.
Obviously. I've moved the cleats, I've tried different socks. The cycling shoes just don't fit my feet. I want a refund.

Of course. I completely understand. Let me just confirm the delivery date here... It looks like you received them 73 days ago. Our policy for standard items like these is 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can process that return and full refund for you right now.

I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. And since I see you're a VIP member with us, I've also gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for the trouble. We appreciate your loyalty and I'm sorry these didn't work out.
You're welcome. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, the refund will be processed to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
